notes: Private-mode tasks on the live-like Google Flights fixture (fixtures/long/flights-live, served at /long/flights-live/ from the fixtures dir). Prompts are written the way a user types to Claude Code and never mention FAI parameters, steps or expectations; `prompt` is sent as is ({{START}} filled). Gold facts are bench/long/tasks.json flights-live-*: the cheapest flight departing 10:00-12:00 over Mon 12 to Sun 18 Oct is easyJet 10:40 AM, EUR 58, Thu 15 Oct, and it is behind "View more flights". Run: node bench/live/run.mjs --private --tasks-file bench/live/tasks-fixture.json --host claude:claude-sonnet-5-5:low --fai-home <checkout> --out bench/live/results/<name>

tasks.shape: starts on the search form: one-way, origin, destination (autocomplete), departure date (calendar dialog, Done), Search, then View more flights and a read
tasks.prompt: My browser tab is open on the Skyline Flights search page ({{START}}). Search one-way flights from Marseille to London departing Thursday 15 October 2026. Which flight departing between 10:00 and 12:00 is the cheapest that day? Check all flights, not just the top few. Give me the airline, departure time and price. Only look, don't book anything.
tasks.notes: Gold: easyJet 10:40 AM EUR 58 (bench/long flights-live answerFacts; the week's cheapest is on Thu 15 Oct, so it is that day's cheapest too).
